content.text:
Only one failing step, which the fix addresses. The change is committed and pushed to `diff2`.

## Summary

**Root cause:** The docs deploy workflow's "Resolve changed docs" step runs `docs/scripts/changed-pages.ts` directly with `node`. That script statically imports `@pantoken/i18n-engine`, whose `exports` map points at `dist/index.mjs` — but nothing had built that package yet on a fresh checkout, so it failed with `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`. Every other place in the repo that needs `@pantoken/i18n-engine` (e.g. [ci.yml](/.github/workflows/ci.yml#L662)'s `vp run -r build`) builds workspace packages first; this step didn't.

**Fix:** Added a `Build changed-pages script dependencies` step (`vp run -F "@pantoken/i18n-engine..." build`) before "Resolve changed docs" in [.github/workflows/docs.yml](/.github/workflows/docs.yml#L182-L187). Verified locally by deleting `tools/i18n-engine/dist` and confirming `changed-pages.ts` fails before the build step and succeeds after it. The subsequent `vp run -F "@pantoken/docs..." build` steps depend on the same package, so they'll hit this build's cache rather than duplicating work.

Committed as `fix(ci): build i18n-engine before resolving changed docs` and pushed to `diff2`. No changeset added since this only touches a CI workflow, not a published package. I didn't trigger the actual `Deploy docs` workflow to re-verify end-to-end since a real run would attempt a production Netlify deploy — let me know if you'd like me to do a manual `workflow_dispatch` run to confirm.
internal packages get changesets so their changelogs track what's happened.
